create_ModuleListInfo_with_modules: create a ModuleListInfo instance with a descriptive info string and a list of PyTorch modules
create_ModuleListInfo_empty: create an empty ModuleListInfo instance with only an info string for later module registration
use_ModuleListInfo_repr: use the ModuleListInfo repr method to get a human-readable description of the module list
append_to_ModuleListInfo: append PyTorch modules to an existing ModuleListInfo instance just like a standard ModuleList
iterate_ModuleListInfo: iterate over a ModuleListInfo instance to access each registered PyTorch module by index
